title: Verify: game/ layout and content load unit tests
summary: Unit tests prove the module layout and that the world loads from game/content
description: Context: loader.loadWorld(worldDir) validates world.yaml and scenes. Desired behavior: tests prove the moved layout exists and the real world loads. Expected result: tests pass from game/.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/, when the layout test runs, then required directories exist and backend/game does not
Given game/content/worlds/the-boys-room, when loadWorld is called, then it returns without throwing
Given the existing suite files, when run from game/, then they pass
technical_constraints: Vitest only, filesystem reads of repo files only, no network

steps.symbol: new: describe('game layout') / it('has runtime dirs and no backend/game')
steps.action: Create the test using fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url)) as gameDir; assert existsSync for src/engine, src/state, src/systems, src/content, content/worlds/the-boys-room/world.yaml and tests, and assert existsSync(join(gameDir,'../backend/game')) is false.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/layout.test.ts

steps.action: Import loadWorld from '../src/content/loader'; call it with join(gameDir,'content/worlds/the-boys-room') and assert the result is defined and does not throw.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/layout.test.ts tests/content.test.ts tests/loader.test.ts
